note: Grade 8 standards listed on the FSD Grade 7 Honors Mathematics syllabus (August 2025). Each attaches to the chapter campaigns of its quarter as HONORS sorties. Required for Blackbird Qualification, not for chapter boss sorties.

skills.name: Rational vs irrational; repeating decimals to fractions
skills.key: Rational numbers can be written as a fraction of integers; their decimals end or repeat. Irrational decimals never end and never repeat (pi, sqrt 2). To turn 0.333... into a fraction, set x = 0.333..., multiply by 10, subtract.
tiers: classify a number as rational or irrational
repeating decimal with one repeating digit to a fraction
two repeating digits (0.4545...)
classify sqrt of perfect vs non-perfect squares; mixed lists
skills.gen: Repeating digits 1-2; foils: sqrt(49), 0.25, 22/7, pi, sqrt(50).
skills.skin: sensor readouts that repeat vs. drift, Mach values as fractions

skills.name: Estimate square roots; order irrationals
skills.key: Bracket the root between two perfect squares (sqrt 40 is between 6 and 7, closer to 6). Estimate to the tenth or hundredth, then place it on the number line.
tiers: which two whole numbers is sqrt n between
estimate to the nearest tenth
estimate to the nearest hundredth; order a set including pi and fractions
estimate an expression like 2 sqrt 10 + 1
skills.gen: n in [2,150] non-square; sets of 4-5 values for ordering.
skills.skin: distance estimates from radar area, runway diagonal estimates

skills.name: Properties of integer exponents
skills.key: Same base, multiplying: add exponents. Dividing: subtract. Power of a power: multiply. Anything to the 0 is 1. A negative exponent means 1 over the positive power.
tiers: product rule, positive exponents
quotient rule; zero exponent
negative exponents; power of a power
mixed expressions with two bases; evaluate numerically
skills.gen: Bases 2-10 and x; exponents in [-5,8]. Evaluations kept under 10^6.
skills.skin: signal strength halving with distance (2^-n), squadron doubling

skills.name: Estimate with single digit times a power of 10
skills.key: Round a big or tiny number to one digit times a power of 10. Compare sizes by comparing the exponents: 4 x 10^8 is about 200 times 2 x 10^6.
tiers: tiny numbers with negative exponents
how many times larger is A than B
order several quantities given in mixed forms
skills.gen: Exponents in [-9,12].

errors.desc: subtracts instead of dividing when comparing

skills.skin: aircraft range in meters, radar wavelength, fleet cost

skills.name: Scientific notation: operations and units
skills.key: Coefficient must be at least 1 and less than 10. Multiply: multiply coefficients, add exponents, then fix the coefficient. Add: match the exponents first. Pick units so the number is easy to read.
tiers: convert standard <-> scientific notation
multiply and divide in scientific notation
add and subtract (match exponents); fix coefficients >= 10
choose appropriate units (km vs m) in a context
skills.gen: Coefficients to 2 decimals; exponents in [-6,9].

errors.desc: reverses the exponent sign for small numbers

skills.skin: SR-71 range in meters, fuel mass in grams, fleet totals

skills.name: Multi-step equations with variables on both sides
skills.khan: K8-ALG:equations with variables on both sides
skills.key: Simplify each side (distribute, combine). Move the variable terms to one side, constants to the other. Divide. Check.
tiers: ax + b = cx + d, integers
distribute on one side first
rational coefficients; distribute on both sides
context: two fuel plans, when are they equal
skills.gen: Choose x first; a != c; T3 decimals and fractions.

errors.desc: moves a term without changing its sign
distributes to the first term only

skills.skin: when two aircraft at different speeds/starts meet, cost comparison of two loadouts

skills.name: One, none, or infinitely many solutions
skills.key: If solving leaves x = a number: one solution. A false statement like 3 = 5: no solution. A true statement like 4 = 4: infinitely many.
tiers: classify after simplifying, integers
requires distributing first
write an equation that has no / infinite solutions
context interpretation
skills.gen: Build from the three cases with equal probability; disguise with distribution.
skills.skin: can two flight plans ever coincide? always, never, once

skills.name: Dilations and scale factors
skills.key: A dilation multiplies every distance from the center by the scale factor k. k > 1 enlarges, 0 < k < 1 shrinks. On coordinates centered at the origin: (x, y) -> (kx, ky).
tiers: find k from two corresponding lengths
dilate a point from the origin
dilate a figure; perimeter scales by k, area by k^2
identify the center and k from a picture
skills.skin: scale model vs full airframe, zooming the tactical map

skills.name: Slope as unit rate; compare proportional relationships
skills.key: On a proportional graph the slope IS the unit rate, and the line passes through (0, 0). Compare two relationships by comparing slopes, even if one is a table and one is a graph.
tiers: slope of a line through the origin from two points
compare a graph to an equation: which is faster
compare graph vs table vs description
interpret the point (1, r) and (0, 0) in context
skills.gen: Rates in {0.5..6}; representations rotated.
skills.skin: two aircraft fuel-burn graphs, speed comparison from table vs graph

skills.name: Derive y = mx + b
skills.key: Slope m = rise / run = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1), the same between any two points (similar triangles). b is where the line crosses the y-axis. y = mx + b.
tiers: slope from two points
read m and b from a graph; write the equation
write the equation from two points
context: fuel = -12t + 900, interpret m and b
skills.gen: m in {-4..4} and simple fractions; b in [-10,10]; points on grid -10..10.
skills.skin: fuel remaining over time, altitude during a descent, credits over missions

skills.name: Systems of two linear equations: how many solutions
skills.key: Two lines: cross once (one solution), parallel (no solution: same slope, different intercept), or the same line (infinitely many).
tiers: from a graph
from two equations in y = mx + b form
equations not in slope-intercept form
context: will two flight paths ever meet
skills.gen: Cases equally likely; slopes in [-3,3], intercepts in [-8,8].
skills.skin: intercept geometry: do two headings ever cross

skills.name: Estimate a system's solution by graphing
skills.key: The solution is the point where the two lines cross. Graph both, read the crossing, check it in both equations.
tiers: read the crossing point off a graph
graph two equations and find the integer crossing
estimate a non-integer crossing
context: where and when two aircraft meet
skills.gen: Choose the crossing point first (integers on grid), build two lines through it.
skills.skin: two aircraft position vs time, intercept point on a grid

skills.name: Graph a linear inequality
skills.key: Graph the boundary line (dashed for < or >, solid for <= or >=), test a point like (0, 0), shade the side that makes it true.
tiers: one-variable inequality on a number line (review)
y > mx + b: pick the correct graph
shade the region; dashed vs solid
is a given point a solution
skills.gen: m in [-3,3], b in [-6,6]; test points off the line.
skills.skin: safe-altitude zones vs distance, no-fly regions
skills.note: Tennessee-specific standard; OUR's TN edition Grade 8 Unit 4 adds lessons for it.

skills.name: What a function is
skills.key: A function gives exactly ONE output for each input. Same input, two different outputs: not a function. (Two inputs with the same output is fine.)
tiers: function or not from a mapping diagram
from a table of values
from a graph (vertical line test) and a set of ordered pairs
from a description or equation
skills.gen: Half functions, half not; foils repeat an output (still a function) to catch the reverse error.

errors.desc: same output twice = not a function

skills.skin: throttle setting -> thrust; tail number -> pilot

skills.name: Compare linear functions across representations
skills.key: Find the rate of change (slope) and initial value (y-intercept) in each representation, then compare those two numbers.
tiers: rate of change from a table vs a graph
initial value from words vs equation
which has the greater rate; which starts higher
translate one representation into another
skills.gen: Rates in [-5,5], intercepts in [-20,20]; two functions per item in different forms.

errors.desc: compares intercepts when rate was asked
reads the change in y without dividing by change in x

skills.skin: two aircraft fuel plans in table vs graph vs words

skills.name: Linear vs nonlinear; interpret y = mx + b
skills.key: Linear means a constant rate of change: equal steps in x give equal steps in y, and the graph is a straight line. y = x^2 is not linear.
tiers: linear or not from a graph
from a table (constant differences)
from an equation
interpret m and b for y = mx + b in context
skills.gen: Tables with constant vs changing differences; equations with x^2, 1/x, |x| as foils.

errors.desc: a curve that looks straight over a small range

skills.skin: altitude vs time in a climb (linear) vs a stall (curve)

skills.name: Construct a linear function to model a relationship
skills.key: Rate of change from two points or from the story ('burns 12 L per minute' -> m = -12). Initial value is what you have at time 0. Then y = mx + b.
tiers: from a description with rate and start
from two (x, y) values
from a graph or table with no (0, b) row
interpret m and b in the situation; predict
skills.gen: Rates in [-15,15], starts in [0,1000].

errors.desc: uses the first table row as b

skills.skin: fuel = 900 - 12t, altitude during descent, credits over missions

skills.name: Qualitative graphs
skills.key: Read a graph as a story: rising means increasing, flat means constant, steeper means faster. Sketch the story the same way.
tiers: match a graph to a description
describe intervals (increasing/decreasing/constant)
sketch a graph from a description (choose among 4)
compare two stories' graphs
skills.gen: Stories: takeoff-cruise-descent, refuel, holding pattern; 4 candidate sketches.

errors.desc: reads the graph as the flight path

skills.skin: altitude vs time for a full sortie

skills.name: Scatter plots and two-way tables
skills.key: Scatter plot: look for clusters, outliers, and whether the points trend up (positive), down (negative), or nowhere (none), and whether the trend is straight (linear). Two-way table: rows and columns count two categories; relative frequency is a row or column share.
tiers: describe association from a scatter plot
identify outliers and clusters
build/complete a two-way table
relative frequencies and whether the two categories are associated
skills.gen: Point sets of 10-20 with controlled correlation; tables 2x2 to 3x3 with totals.

errors.desc: reports counts when shares were asked

skills.skin: altitude vs speed radar tracks; aircraft type x fault type maintenance table

skills.name: Line of fit
skills.key: A line of fit runs through the middle of the cloud with about as many points above as below. Judge fit by how close the points stay to the line.
tiers: choose the best of 3 lines
drag a line to fit
judge fit: strong / weak
spot a line pulled by an outlier
skills.gen: Correlated point sets; candidate lines offset or rotated.

errors.desc: hits the most points regardless of balance

skills.skin: fit a trend to lock time vs pilot experience

skills.name: Use a linear model; interpret slope and intercept
skills.key: In y = mx + b for data, m is 'each extra unit of x adds m to y' and b is the predicted y when x = 0. Use the equation to predict.
tiers: predict y from x with the equation
interpret m in context
interpret b, including when it is meaningless
predict x from y
skills.gen: m in [-5,5] simple decimals; b in [0,100].
skills.skin: predict fuel burn from payload weight

skills.name: Probability of compound events
skills.key: List every outcome of the combined event, then P = favorable / total, exactly like a simple event. For independent events, P(A and B) = P(A) x P(B).
tiers: two coins / two spinners: P of a specific pair
P(both) using the product
P(at least one); 'without replacement' by listing
three-stage events
skills.gen: Two to three stages, 2-6 outcomes each; keep totals <= 36.

errors.desc: total = outcomes per stage, not the product

skills.skin: weather clear AND radar lock; two missiles both hit

skills.name: Sample spaces for compound events
skills.key: Build the sample space with an organized list, a table, or a tree diagram; count the outcomes that match the event in words ('doubles', 'at least one 6').
tiers: count outcomes for two events
complete a table or tree
identify the outcomes matching a phrase
three events
skills.gen: Dice, coins, spinners, menus; counts <= 36.
skills.skin: loadout combinations, mission outcome trees

skills.name: Square and cube roots
skills.key: sqrt(p) is the side of a square with area p; cbrt(p) is the edge of a cube with volume p. Solve x^2 = p and x^3 = p with roots.
tiers: square roots of perfect squares to 225
cube roots of perfect cubes to 1000
solve x^2 = p, x^3 = p
roots of fractions and decimals (sqrt 1/4, sqrt 0.09)
skills.gen: Perfect squares 1..225, cubes 1..1000.
skills.skin: side of a square landing pad from area, edge of a cubic fuel cell

skills.name: Parallel lines cut by a transversal
skills.key: When parallel lines are crossed, corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and same-side interior angles add to 180.
tiers: name the angle pair
find an angle given one
write and solve an equation for x
multi-step with a triangle formed by the transversal
skills.gen: Angles in [30,150]; T3 choose x for whole angles.
skills.skin: parallel runways crossed by a taxiway, formation flight lines

skills.name: Model of the Pythagorean theorem
skills.key: In a right triangle the squares on the two legs add up to the square on the hypotenuse: a^2 + b^2 = c^2. The converse: if a^2 + b^2 = c^2, the triangle is right.
tiers: identify legs and hypotenuse
check a^2 + b^2 = c^2 with squares drawn
is this a right triangle (converse)
explain the area model
skills.skin: climb triangle: ground distance, altitude, flight path

skills.name: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find a length
skills.key: Missing hypotenuse: c = sqrt(a^2 + b^2). Missing leg: a = sqrt(c^2 - b^2). Always take the square root at the end.
tiers: hypotenuse from two legs (triples)
leg from hypotenuse and a leg
non-integer results to the tenth
context: ladder/ramp/flight path; diagonal of a rectangle
skills.gen: Triples for T1-T2; T3 legs in [2,20] non-triple.

errors.desc: adds when solving for a leg

skills.skin: 9 km east, 12 km north: direct distance to target; diagonal of a hangar

skills.name: Distance between points on a coordinate plane
skills.key: Draw the right triangle between the two points; the legs are the differences in x and y. Then a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
tiers: points with a horizontal/vertical leg drawn
two points in the first quadrant
points across quadrants (negative coordinates)
perimeter of a triangle on the grid
skills.gen: Grid -10..10; prefer triple-based distances, some non-integer.
skills.skin: distance between two radar contacts on the tactical grid

skills.name: Volume of cones, cylinders, and spheres
skills.key: Cylinder V = pi r^2 h. Cone = 1/3 of the cylinder with the same base and height. Sphere V = 4/3 pi r^3.
tiers: cylinder volume
cone volume; compare to the cylinder
sphere and hemisphere
missing dimension; composite (cylinder with cone nose)
skills.gen: r in [1,15], h in [1,30]; accept 3.14 or 'pi' form.
skills.skin: external fuel tank, nose cone, radome, missile body
